Limited palette, dark brown outline, flat clusters of pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no texture, no shadow outside icon. Readable as a tiny game sprite, original art without copying existing game assets. Subject: A single bold orange and gold flame representing enthusiasm and rising fighting spirit. Three simple flame tips, one pale yellow inner flame, strong recognizable silhouette.
